description:
Adds Clients (people the practice does MTD quarterly updates for) from a pasted list; matches existing Clients by email, else exact name. confirm:false (default) shows what would be added, skipped as duplicates, or rejected, and the plan-limit effect; confirm:true saves. Max 500.
Use this when: setting up or adding MTD clients from a spreadsheet or accounting-software export, or a typed list.
Not for: changing one Client (update_client).

period_type.description: standard = periods end on the 5th; calendar = month-end

confirm.description: false (default) = dry run: shows what would happen, changes nothing. true = do it.

idempotency_key.description: Optional; reuse when retrying so the change happens once.

name: add_clients
title: Add Clients
